policy.title: Management Policy
body: Lua upholds customer value creation, technological innovation, and respect for talent as three core principles.
All decisions are based on sustainable growth and social responsibility.
We continue R&D investment and quality management to strengthen competitiveness in global markets.

ethics.title: Ethical Management
intro: Lua builds trust with stakeholders through transparent and fair management.
All employees comply with the code of ethics, and violations are addressed immediately.

principles.title: Integrity
principles.body: Maintain honesty based on facts in all business activities.

principles.title: Fairness
principles.body: Practice fair decision-making and transactions free from conflicts of interest.

principles.title: Responsibility
principles.body: Take responsibility for outcomes and meet societal expectations.

principles.title: Respect
principles.body: Respect colleagues, customers, and partners to build mutual trust.

reporting.title: Reporting & Consultation
body: Ethical violations can be reported to the ethics office or via ethics@example.com.
Reporter identity is strictly protected, and appropriate action is taken after verification.

esg.title: ESG Management
intro: Lua manages Environment, Social, and Governance in an integrated manner.
We create long-term value through sustainable management and grow together with stakeholders.

pillars.title: Environment (E)
body: Carbon emission reduction and energy efficiency improvement
Adoption of eco-friendly materials and processes
Compliance with environmental regulations and voluntary targets
